impacts.reason: The DoS on unregistration directly concerns the intent that unregisterVault succeed when empty and that dust not block it; the empty/deactivated and zero-balance preconditions are explicitly stated.
The permanent revert on nonzero balance directly violates the stated intent that unregistration succeed when empty and that donated dust not block it.
The DoS on the administrative unregister function directly concerns the intent that unregisterVault succeed when empty and not be blocked by dust.
Blocking migration via unregisterVault failure directly concerns the intent that unregistration succeed when empty and not be blocked by dust.
Blocking decommissioning via unregisterVault failure directly concerns the intent that unregistration succeed when empty and not be blocked by dust.
Blocking emergency cleanup via unregisterVault failure directly concerns the intent that unregistration succeed when empty and not be blocked by dust.
The cross-asset DoS on unregistration directly concerns the intent that unregisterVault succeed when empty and that dust not block it.
The absence of a sweep/recovery function is a factual condition, not an explicit security intent directly stating expected behavior for this impact.
